correctness.rationale: Induction on syntax gives the root undefinedness support: negation and the locally infectious box preserve it, disjunction unions it, J_2 erases it, and constants have empty support. Distinct supports are distinguished by setting just a letter in their symmetric difference to u at a chosen root. The depth signatures truncate recursively by truncating every type in the successor set. Hence the depth-d signature fixes the previous-depth signature at the root and all previous-depth successor types, which suffices to evaluate a boxed operand, including at a dead end. For the converse, all three atomic colors have Boolean tests. A characteristic formula conjoins the root color test with box of the disjunction of the required successor-type tests and diamond of each required test, where diamond is negation-box-negation on Boolean-valued formulas. Empty conjunction and disjunction work at dead ends. These tests give arbitrary Boolean decisions on realized types; multiplying by the weak-Kleene conjunction of p_i or not p_i over the chosen support exactly inserts the prescribed u values. Thus the sum counts term functions with no overcount. On a cycle the recursive singleton successor signatures read the entire prefix of length min(d+1,n), after which they just repeat previous colors; every such prefix occurs. The exponents, small counts, and strict growth for k>=1 before saturation follow, including the trivial n=1 cutoff. For k=0 the cycle gives two functions at all depths, although nonserial frames can have nontrivial uncolored types. As a separate finite check, direct evaluation of the characteristic tests on a root with two terminal successors, with one letter and depth one, distinguished all 21 types (14 classical at the root) across all 81 world/valuation pairs.
residual_risks: The proof counts output equivalence on a fixed finite nonempty frame over unrestricted valuations. It does not transfer the depth census to a different primitive modality or to provability equivalence across frames.
The frozen script was inspected, not executed; its reported cycle closures are finite corroboration and do not check all frames or the depth-two large count by saturation.
